question.problem: What is the solution to the equation $a - 3 = 4?$
question.worked_solution:
If we substitute ${\color{blue}{a}}={\color{blue}{7}}$ into the given equation, we get a true statement:

$$
\begin{aligned}a-3 & =4 \\ 7-3 & =4 \\ 4 & =4\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $a=7.$
